resources.string: Files remain recoverable for 30 days after they are moved.

Only these files will be moved for 30 days. They will also disappear from Deemix and Jellyfin. Playlist and favourite references are retained for restoration. Automatic downloads remain blocked until you explicitly allow them again.
Checking the selected files in the background. This may take a moment.

These files have expired. Automatic downloads remain blocked.
